Witness Name: Hime Haymanot Gashaw AKA
Haymanot Gashaw
Statement No.: 1
Dated: 19.05.18
THE GRENFELL TOWER INQUIRY
WITNESS STATEMENT OF HIME HAYMANOT GASHAW AKA HAYMANOT
GASHAW
FLAT 131, 16”' FLOOR
I, Hime Haymanot Gashaw AKA Haymanot Gashaw of
formerly of Flat 131 (16* Floor) Grenfell Tower will say as follows:-
INTRODUCTION
1. I am a core participant in the Grenfell Tower Inquiry and a survivor from the dreadful fire
on 14 June 2017.
2. I make this statement on behalf of myself and my daughter S[ophia Lilly Naty] Fletcher
we call our daughter by her second name,. L[illy]. My husband Richard
Fletcher 74] and the father of our daughter L[illy], has made his own witness
statement on his own behalf as well as also on behalf of our daughter.
I have made a statement to the Metropolitan Police and confirm that I consent to any
police statement I have made being disclosed to the Grenfell Tower Public Inquiry.
4. At the time of the fire I was 40 years old and my daughter was 6 years old
5. My family are the most important thing in my life and a tragedy like this and being so
close to losing them makes you realise just how fragile life is and to appreciate it.
1
Hime GASHAW
IWS00000990 00016. I lived in Grenfell Tower with my husband for approximately 16 years up until the time
of the fire. Our daughter had lived there for her whole life.
7. This statement is mainly about our experiences on 14 June 2017 and deals with what the
Inquiry have called ‘Phase 1’ matters, setting out what happened to us when the fire broke
out and burnt Grenfell Tower, my family’s home. I will provide greater detail of ‘Phase
2’ matters as the Inquiry progresses and although I will set out some brief details of what
Phase 2 matters are later in this statement I will do so without having seen disclosure of
the documentation that is anticipated will be given for Phase 2 and in particular without
sight of my housing file from the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea (‘RBKC’).
8. The 14”' June 2017 is a day I and my family will never forget. We lost everything
including our home. Amazingly, and thankfully, we survived although we nearly
perished in the fire along with many others. This is our story in my words.
The evening of the 13 June 2017
9. On the night before the morning of the fire, I was at home with Richard and our daughter.
Earlier in the evening Richard had popped out to the shops get me a bottle of coke. Once
he got back we settled down to a night in front of the tv. My daughter went to bed at
about 8pm, in fact to our bed as she would sometimes sleep in with us. Richard and I
carried on watching tv together.
10.1 watched tv up until about 10pm and then went to bed. I got into our bed where L[illy]
was asleep. Richard carried on watching tv as he didn’t have work in the morning.
The Morning of the 14 June 2017
11.1 understand from information since provided to me that the fire started at 00:54 on the
morning of 14 June 2017.
12. Having gone to bed at about 10pm, next to L[illy], I soon fell asleep. In terms of
becoming aware of the fire, I would not have done so if it had not been for the fact that
Richard woke me up.
2
Hime GASHAW
